The split form is exactly the Lean right-hand side Pi_n' = p.radial = pressureValue C b s phi, which unfolds to 2 * C^{-2} * (phi 0).value * (phi n).value + C^{-2} * lowerConvolution n (phi_i phi_j) - omegaQuotient/2; lowerConvolution n F = ∑_{i ∈ range(n-1)} F (i+1) (n-i-1) is the paper's ∑_{i=1}^{n-1} phi_i phi_{n-i} (empty for n = 1, as the paper notes). pressureValue_eq_convolution proves this equals the unsplit (5.5) right-hand side for 0 < n, via convolution_split (line 271: convolution n F = F 0 n + F n 0 + lowerConvolution n F), which is the paper's 'the pressure equation separates into'. The same encoding caveat as for (5.5) applies: the last term is -omegaQuotient/2 with omegaQuotient the division-free previousOmegaDivX, equal to Omega_{n-1}/X for X ≠ 0 by omega_axisFactor (AxisSourceRegularity.lean:133).
